text:
jess (Finance): Heads-up: Batch invoice run produced incorrect totals for NimbusCo and a duplicate invoice for Solstice. Example: INV-2024-3052 and INV-2024-3052-dup. The PDF total $6,240.00 doesn't equal ledger sum $5,740.00.
kai (Billing Eng): Can you paste the raw line dump?
jess (Finance): Sure:
```
line_items:
 - sku: reserved_gpu_hours
   qty: 200
   unit_cents: 2500
   subtotal_cents: 500000
 - sku: data_transfer
   qty: 5
   unit_cents: 8000
   subtotal_cents: 40000
taxes:
 - code: VAT_EU
   cents: 46000
 - code: VAT_EU
   cents: 46000
```
infra-bot: billing-worker logged: `DecimalException: quantize` at ts=2145693989 then `render retry 3`
kai (Billing Eng): Duplicate VAT + retry suggests tax webhook double-delivered and idempotency failed under retry. Also seeing invoice id written twice with and without `-dup` suffix.
mike (Support): NimbusCo called — they want confirmation before disputing bank transfer. I've told them we won't process payment until resolved.
recon-bot: Scanned last 24h: 9 affected customers, duplicate invoice suffix found in 3 cases.
jess (Finance): Immediate asks: 1) Pause invoice retry loop, 2) reconcile duplicates and prepare credit notes, 3) reissue corrected invoices with clear explanation.
kai (Billing Eng): Paused retries at ts=2145694030. Patch plan: 1) dedupe tax entries by tax code+jurisdiction, 2) require finalizer strict total check before persisting invoice id, 3) include idempotency token in PDF metadata. Deploy ETA 30m.
jess (Finance): Also add one-off goodwill credit $75 for impacted accounts.
recon-bot: Exported list: nimbusco-12, solstice-77, aurora-03, zephyr-42, luminous-77, arcadia-09, helios-21, venturex-05, prisma-88
kai (Billing Eng): PR merged and deployed at ts=2145694310. Regen job started. Results: regen success 7/9, fail 2/9 (arcadia-09 migration hole, luminous-77 corrupted commitment).
jess (Finance): Which two failed so we can take manual steps?
kai (Billing Eng): arcadia-09 and luminous-77. I'm creating manual reconcile tickets and will attach DB backups.
mike (Support): I'll send customer updates and set expectation 3-5 business days for credit processing.
jess (Finance): Filing incident for billing. Please keep webhook payloads archived for 48h. We'll include a postmortem once remediated.
recon-bot: Credit notes queued for 8 accounts at ts=2145694590.
